prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1380; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented after a side-impact collision at an intersection with a wrist fracture. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported crash and the force involved. The patient was seen four times over the course of care. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visits becoming less frequent as symptoms improved and function returned. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm the fracture. The patient also had treatment for the same body region within the past two years, and that earlier condition contributes to some of the current complaints, so the present symptoms should be interpreted with that history in mind. Billing records reflect single entries for each service with no repeated charges. At the most recent visit, the patient reported improved grip strength and reduced pain, and the treating plan calls for continued home exercises with reassessment as needed.
